checkpoints.note: The configuration state created in `flb_parser_create()` makes `flb_parser_do()` dispatch the trailing 58-byte payload into `flb_parser_logfmt_do()` instead of the regex, JSON, or LTSV handlers.

First project-side consumption of the fuzzed configuration prefix. `flb_parser_create()` sees `format == "logfmt"` and stores `FLB_PARSER_LOGFMT` in the parser object, which later makes `flb_parser_do()` route the payload into `logfmt_parser()`.

Root cause. After parser creation set `parser->time_with_year = FLB_TRUE`, the else-path in `flb_parser_time_lookup()` leaves `time_ptr` aliased to the bounded six-byte slice `80446.` and forwards it directly to `flb_strptime()` even though logfmt values are not NUL-terminated C strings. The fix adds the missing temporary copy and explicit terminator immediately before this call.
